$comment: Straits Meridian Bank demo storyline (~6 minutes). Each beat: who, what they do, what the screen shows, and the SSE event it emits (if any).
setup: Window A: sign in as priscilla (CISO)
Window B: sign in as rahul (terminal + /me)
Click Reset demo once as weiling before starting

beats.title: CISO frames it
expect: Deployment step 3 of 4 (Full containment next)
23 of 27 services governed
Shadow share 3.1 % (5.4 % previous week)
90 % endpoints enforcing (371 / 412)
17 / 17 critical detections contained
0 card or NRIC records left the bank
3 decisions awaiting the CISO

beats.title: Developer works
beats.action: aegis run claude-code --src ./settlement-recon --writable, then claude "find why yesterday's card settlement is off by SGD 1,240"

DLP blocks card PAN + NRIC before the prompt leaves
/me · My blocked events explains why and how to fix

beats.title: Security triages
beats.screen: /console · Home → Protect → Detections → Blast radius → Discover
beats.action: Open the escalated card-data detection, open the blast-radius tree, review Payments CUE draft v4 (dlp-mask-query-results), open DeepSeek, label Perplexity Under review, try Approve on confluence.
expect: Tree LT-SG-2231 → Payments v3 → postgres-mcp (Aegis Bridge) → .env → cards.txn_ledger 1,240 rows → Blocked before prompt left the sandbox
Perplexity moves to Under review (24 of 27 governed)
Approve is refused: only Tan Wei Ling (Admin) or Priscilla Goh (CISO) can approve MCP servers

beats.title: Developer asks
beats.action: aegis mcp request confluence --reason "read runbooks while debugging settlement"
expect: Terminal: scan passed, awaiting decision
Toast in Admin and CISO consoles: Rahul Iyer is asking for confluence
/me · My MCP requests shows confluence · awaiting decision

beats.title: CISO decides
beats.action: Approve confluence for Engineering — Payments, then publish Payments CUE v4 (demo bar or console).
expect: confluence Onboarded · access Engineering — Payments
claude-code/payments-eng@v4 signed; push queued
Terminal announces the signed v4 CUE

beats.title: Developer unblocked
beats.action: claude "open the runbook for settlement retries", then claude "summarise today's settlement exceptions"
expect: confluence runbook opens (allowed by group MCP policy)
Query result arrives masked by dlp-mask-query-results; task succeeds; no detection

beats.title: Admin closes the loop
beats.action: Review CUE drift, the silent Zscaler sensor and contractor recertification, then Reset demo.
expect: 6 Payments endpoints still on v3 catching up (17 endpoints on older CUEs in total)
Sensor sase_zscaler silent for 2 h 40 m
Vendor Engineering (contractors) recertification due in 14 days
